Class DashboardController

java.lang.Object
com.sebastiandorata.musicdashboard.controller.DashboardController
@Controller public class DashboardController extends Object
Serves the My Dashboard page and the JSON endpoints that refresh its panels.

The desktop DashboardController assembled a stat card row, a Recently Played panel, a Top 5 Artists panel and a line chart around the large player. On the web the page itself (GET /dashboard) is rendered with the initial data already in the model, so it is complete without JavaScript; dashboard.js then calls the /api/dashboard/** endpoints to redraw the chart and to refresh the panels whenever the playing song changes.

SRP: only maps routes and flattens view-model results into JSON-friendly records; all data is computed by StatCardsViewModel, TopArtistsViewModel, ChartViewModel and PlaybackTrackingService.

DIP: depends on those services, never on repositories. Entities are never returned from the JSON endpoints; they are mapped to the records below.

      @GetMapping("/dashboard") public String dashboard(org.springframework.ui.Model model)

      Model attributes: stats (DashboardController.StatCardsJson), recent (list of DashboardController.RecentRow), topArtists (list of DashboardController.TopArtistRow), years (selectable chart years, newest first), selectedYear and allTime (DashboardController.AllTimeStatsJson for the selected year).

    • chart

      @GetMapping("/api/dashboard/chart") @ResponseBody public DashboardController.ChartJson chart(@RequestParam(required=false) Integer year)
      Returns the chart series and all-time stats for one year.

      Time Complexity: O(y + n) where y = years with history, n = playback rows.

      Space Complexity: O(1): at most three series of twelve values.

      Parameters:
      year - the selected year; defaults to the current calendar year
      Returns:
      the chart payload
      Throws:
      org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException - BAD_REQUEST when the year is outside 1900-2200
